q: My new phone is (expensive) ___ my old one, but it is much better.
explain: Stopień wyższy długiego przymiotnika: more expensive than.

q: Would you (mind/close/window) ___, please? It is freezing in here.
explain: Po mind używamy formy -ing: Would you mind closing the window?

q: When Grandma was young, she (use/walk) ___ five kilometres to school every day.
explain: Dawny nawyk: used to + bezokolicznik.

q: Do you think you (ever/able/speak) ___ Japanese fluently?
answers: will ever be able to speak
would ever be able to speak
explain: Przyszła zdolność: will be able to; ever stoi po will.

q: Maria (be/learn) ___ the guitar for three months now, and she is already quite good.
explain: Czynność trwa do teraz: Present Perfect Continuous.

q: What will you do if you (be/not/choose) ___ for the school team?
explain: Zdanie warunkowe I okresu w stronie biernej: if + Present Simple (are not chosen).

q: The teacher asked us (we/finish) ___ the project the week before.
explain: Pytanie zamknięte w mowie zależnej: if/whether + Past Perfect (czas cofnięty).

q: The old theatre (recently/be/repair) ___ by a team of volunteers.
explain: Strona bierna w Present Perfect: has been repaired; recently stoi po has.

q: I (rather/not/go) ___ out tonight. I am too tired.
explain: Preferencja: would rather + not + bezokolicznik bez to.

q: You have already seen this film, (you) ___?
explain: Question tag do zdania twierdzącego z have: haven't you?

q: Sam is (such/lazy) ___ boy that he never helps with anything.
explain: Such + a/an + przymiotnik + rzeczownik: such a lazy boy.

q: Dad told me (clean/I/room) ___ immediately.
explain: Polecenie w mowie zależnej: told + osoba + to + bezokolicznik; I zmienia się w my.

q: I am not sure (the/store/be) ___ open on Sundays.
explain: Pytanie pośrednie: if/whether + szyk zdania twierdzącego.

q: (you/be) ___ scared if you had to speak in front of a thousand people?
explain: II okres warunkowy w pytaniu: Would you be ...?

q: Emma finishes her homework (far/quick) ___ than her brother does.
explain: Stopień wyższy przysłówka: more quickly; far wzmacnia porównanie.

q: I am looking forward ___ seeing you at the party.
explain: Look forward to + -ing.

q: I have lived in this town ___ I was born.
explain: Since + moment w przeszłości (od kiedy się urodziłem).

q: We stayed at home ___ it was raining heavily.
explain: Spójnik przyczyny: because (also as, since).

q: He asked me ___ I had finished the report.
explain: Pytanie zamknięte w mowie zależnej: if/whether.

q: Your parents must be very proud ___ you.
explain: Przymiotnik + przyimek: proud of.

q: I have been waiting for you ___ two hours!
explain: For + okres czasu.

q: Nobody called, ___ they?
explain: Nobody ma znaczenie przeczące, więc tag jest twierdzący i w liczbie mnogiej they: did they?

q: We had to put ___ the match because of the storm.
explain: Czasownik frazowy: put off (odłożyć na później).

q: She fell asleep ___ the film because she was so tired.
explain: During + wydarzenie trwające w czasie: during the film.

q: There ___ be a mistake. The numbers do not match.
explain: Przypuszczenie: must (najsilniejsze), także may/might/could.

q: I cannot stand ___ up early on Mondays.
explain: Po can't stand następuje forma -ing: getting/waking up.

q: If I ___ you, I would talk to the teacher.
explain: II okres warunkowy: If I were you (dopuszczalne też was).

q: Paul and Eve have not seen ___ other for ten years.
explain: Zaimek wzajemny: each other.

q: I have ___ idea what he is talking about.
explain: I have no idea – nie mam pojęcia.

q: How ___ money do you earn per hour?
explain: Money jest niepoliczalne, więc: How much.

q: The new library is situated ++near the railway station++.
answers: Where is the new library situated?
explain: Pytanie o miejsce: Where is ... situated?

q: Her cousin has broken ++his left arm++.
explain: Pytanie o dopełnienie w Present Perfect: What has her cousin broken?

q: ++Most++ of the students in this class can swim.
answers: How many of the students in this class can swim?
How many students in this class can swim?
explain: Pytanie o liczbę: How many of the students ...? (po how many podmiot nie wymaga do/does).

q: Mia usually does her homework ++by herself++.
answers: How does Mia usually do her homework?
explain: Pytanie o sposób: How does Mia usually do her homework?

q: Peter would like to buy a ++green++ bike.
answers: What colour bike would Peter like to buy?
What color bike would Peter like to buy?
explain: Pytanie o kolor: What colour bike would Peter like to buy?

q: This is ++Lucy's++ phone.
explain: Pytanie o właściciela: Whose phone is this?

q: Adam needs to take his medicine ++three times a day++.
answers: How often does Adam need to take his medicine?
explain: Pytanie o częstotliwość: How often does Adam need to take ...?

q: The window was broken ++by a football++.
answers: What was the window broken by?
By what was the window broken?
explain: Pytanie o sprawcę-rzecz w stronie biernej: What was the window broken by?

q: Her parents like ++the first++ season of the series best.
answers: Which season of the series do her parents like best?
explain: Pytanie o wybór spośród kilku: Which season ...?

q: You have called me ++four times++ today.
answers: How many times have you called me today?
How many times have you called me?
explain: Pytanie o liczbę razy: How many times have you called me?

q:
It is possible that Anna forgot about the meeting. (MIGHT)
Anna ___ about the meeting.
explain: Przypuszczenie o przeszłości: might have + III forma.

q:
There are not enough chairs for everybody. (TOO)
There ___ chairs for everybody.
explain: Za mało policzalnych rzeczy: too few + liczba mnoga.

q:
'Don't touch the paintings,' the guard told us. (NOT)
The guard told us ___ the paintings.
explain: Zakaz w mowie zależnej: told + osoba + not to + bezokolicznik.

q:
This is the only exam that I have not passed yet. (WHICH)
This is the only exam ___ passed yet.
explain: Zdanie przydawkowe: the exam which I haven't passed (podane słowo which w niezmienionej formie).

q:
It is a good idea to buy a ticket in advance. (WORTH)
It is ___ a ticket in advance.
explain: Be worth + -ing: warto coś zrobić.

q:
The match was postponed because of the snow. (DUE)
The match was postponed ___ snow.
explain: Przyczyna przed rzeczownikiem: due to the snow.

q:
Tom and Eve got married in 2015. (MARRIED)
Tom and Eve ___ 2015.
explain: Stan trwający od momentu w przeszłości: have been married since 2015.

q:
Please don't make so much noise. (MIND)
Would you ___ so much noise, please?
explain: Prośba z mind: Would you mind not making ...? (mind + not + -ing).

q:
People think that the old castle is haunted. (THOUGHT)
The old castle ___ haunted.
explain: Konstrukcja bezosobowa: is thought to be (uważa się, że jest).

q:
When I was a child, I played in the street every day. (USED)
When I was a child, I ___ in the street every day.
explain: Dawny nawyk: used to + bezokolicznik.
